AfterShow.Name: Start
AfterShow.Source: const selector = document.getElementById("weekdaySelector");		const days = selector.querySelectorAll(".day");		const UC = this		days.forEach(day => {			day.addEventListener("click", () => toggleDay(day));					// Keyboard support (Enter / Space)			day.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {			if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {				e.preventDefault();				toggleDay(day);			}			});		});				function toggleDay(day) {			day.classList.toggle("active");			console.log(getWorkingDays())			UC.EmployeeWorkingDays = JSON.stringify(getWorkingDays());			const input = document.querySelector('#EMPLOYEEWORKINGDAYS')			input.innerHTML = UC.EmployeeWorkingDays			UC.OnValueChange()		}				function getWorkingDays() {			return Array.from(days)			.filter(day => day.classList.contains("active"))			.map(day => day.dataset.day);		}				window.getWorkingDays = getWorkingDays;

BeforeShow.Name: Init
BeforeShow.Source: try {			console.log('wd', this.EmployeeWorkingDays)			const WorkingDays = JSON.parse(this.EmployeeWorkingDays)			this.MonActive = WorkingDays.includes("Mon")			this.TueActive = WorkingDays.includes("Tue")			this.WedActive = WorkingDays.includes("Wed")			this.ThuActive = WorkingDays.includes("Thu")			this.FriActive = WorkingDays.includes("Fri")		}catch(e){			console.error(e)		}
